lessons_used: Sign in redesign changes have proven helpful, winning 3 out of 8 tests.
Home new flow changes have proven helpful, winning 2 out of 7 tests.
Adoption layout changes have proven helpful, winning 1 out of 3 tests.
Finish hint, home wait info, and home notification changes showed no clear effect across all tests of those kinds.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.

Evidence is still thin for adoption copy, adoption hint, adoption incentive, adoption new_screen, adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_screen, choose_path redesign, finish layout, finish redesign, home redesign, sign_in copy, and sign_in reorder changes as they lack at least two agreeing tests.

candidates.title: Full bleed account sync sign-in redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen into a full-bleed visual layout emphasizing persistent cloud account syncing.
candidates.why: Support logs show 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating confusion around account linking and pet saving.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Secure Your Desktop Pet

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Custom pet validation review new screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated pet validation review screen before finalizing adoption so users can inspect rendered custom pet details.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.8% and support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong.

new_pet_validation.headline: Review Your Pet Companion
new_pet_validation.body: Inspect how your companion looks before finishing adoption setup.

guard.reason: Adds a valid pet validation review screen within onboarding without skipping required steps.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off and support evidence, but new screen changes on adoption consistently drop conversion (-0.6% avg).

candidates.title: Desktop controls two-column finish screen redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro finish screen into a two-column layout highlighting key desktop pet controls and tray interaction hints.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops to 64.8% and support received 3 emails about confusion on controlling, hiding, or talking to pets post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready on Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet or use desktop system tray icons to hide, summon, or talk to your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Redesigns home_intro layout while preserving its onboarding guidance function.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence for finish stage confusion, but finish redesigns consistently fail (-3.1% avg across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Companion rendering animation preview sub-flow
candidates.change: Add an animated pet companion preview visual element during the waiting screen wait sequence.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s) and median of 201s, causing drop-offs while waiting for local desktop setup.

guard.reason: Adds a preview animation sub-flow to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Home new flow is a proven winning category (+1.5% avg, 2 wins) targeting high wait times.

candidates.title: Path selection quick start clarity copy
candidates.change: Update headline and body on the path selection screen to explicitly compare instant preset adoption with custom photo creation.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a high mean time of 514s, showing users hesitate when picking between creation options.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Bring Your Pet to Life
choose_path.body: Pick an instant preset pet companion or upload photos to create a custom pet.

guard.reason: Updates choose_path copy while retaining both adoption options.

candidates.score_note: Easy copy fix, but choose_path copy tests average -0.3% across 5 tests.

candidates.title: Sign in cloud save persistent hint
candidates.change: Display an explicit guidance hint on the sign-in screen explaining automatic companion syncing across device sessions.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.

sign_in.hint: Signing in connects your desktop pet to your cloud profile so progress is never lost.

guard.reason: Adds a cloud save guidance hint on the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email signal (8 emails), but hint changes historically show zero to negative effect.

candidates.title: Pick friend carousel layout redesign
candidates.change: Switch the pet selection view on pick friend screen to a interactive horizontal carousel layout.
candidates.why: Adoption step has the lowest non-finish completion rate at 69.8%, needing a smoother visual browsing experience.

guard.reason: Switches pick_friend view to a carousel layout without losing its core selection job.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes are proven helpful (+3.2% avg) targeting the largest non-finish funnel drop.

candidates.title: Desktop pet taskbar launch instructions copy
candidates.change: Update final screen text to instruct users directly on desktop taskbar tray icons and pet interactions.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide pets on the desktop.

home_intro.headline: Your Desktop Companion is Live!
home_intro.body: Look for the pet icon in your system taskbar to manage companion visibility, sounds, and interactions.

guard.reason: Updates home_intro instructions copy within allowed onboarding bounds.

candidates.score_note: Config/copy only change addressing frequent post-onboarding support complaints.

candidates.title: Choose path compact card layout
candidates.change: Change choose path screen layout to compact mode to streamline option scanning.
candidates.why: Reducing friction on choose path (mean 514s) helps users move into pet setup faster.

guard.reason: Changes choose_path screen to a compact card layout.

candidates.score_note: Layout change targeting long hesitation time on choose_path, though evidence is limited to 1 test.

candidates.title: Interactive story scroll onboarding intro layout
candidates.change: Update the initial story screen layout to story_scroll for an engaging visual intro before choosing a creation path.
candidates.why: Setting clearer expectations early improves overall funnel completion (currently 26.9%).

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience
story.body: Explore how virtual pets roam your screen, react to work habits, and keep you company.

guard.reason: Updates story screen to a story_scroll layout while introducing the pet.

candidates.score_note: High cost implementation with thin evidence for story scroll layout performance.
